channel.title: Jeju Travel News
channel.description: Reviewed Jeju travel guides in English: places to visit, beaches, oreum trails, cafes and stays with practical route notes.

item.title: Seongsan Sunrise Peak Itinerary
item.description: A relaxed eastern half-day loop built around sunrise at Seongsan Ilchulbong, then breakfast near Seongsan Port and a walk along Gwangchigi Beach.

item.title: Hyeopjae Beach Half-Day Route
item.description: A western half-day built around Hyeopjae Beach's turquoise water — a walk, a meal, and a café — planned around the tide, light and parking rather than a fixed schedule.

item.title: Hamdeok Beach Café Walk
item.description: A northeastern half-day pairing a walk at Hamdeok Beach with one good café, planned so you park once instead of chasing parking spots back and forth.

item.title: Udo Island Day Trip
item.description: The full sequence for an Udo day trip — getting to Seongsan Port, choosing how to get around the island, hitting the key stops, and not missing the last ferry back.

item.title: Hallasan for First-Time Hikers
item.description: How a first-time hiker should actually choose a Hallasan trail — based on fitness, transport, reservations, and how much time you'll need coming back down, not the summit alone.

item.title: How to Choose Where to Stay in Jeju
item.description: A practical comparison of where to base yourself in Jeju — Jeju-si, Seogwipo, the east, and the west — built around your actual itinerary and evening convenience, not airport distance.

item.title: Jeju Destinations That Work Well With Family
item.description: Choosing Jeju destinations for a family trip by restrooms, slope and an indoor backup — how easy each place is to actually move around, not just how well-known it is.

item.title: Rainy-Day Indoor Jeju
item.description: A ground rule for a rainy or windy day in Jeju: stay within one area, and link a museum, a market and a café without much driving in between.
